results.title: Who is really profiting from Myanmar’s jade?
results.description:
Who is really profiting from Myanmar’s jade? 
---#WhatsHappeningInMyanmar
Evidence reveals a network of illegal jade mining blocks in Hpakant, Kachin State, granted by KIA insurgents. With daily shipments of fuel entering from China to power these unauthorized operations, local communities are taking a stand, loudly protesting the ruthless exploitation of state wealth by KIA insurgents and its network.

results.title: Myanmar is where a lot of China's heavy rare earth feed comes from, mostly ionic clay out of Kachin.
results.description: Myanmar is where a lot of China's heavy rare earth feed comes from, mostly ionic clay out of Kachin. Even if the US got access, that ore still goes to China to be separated today. More feed doesn't help much until there's somewhere outside China to process it.

results.title: Most of Myanmar’s manganese mines have been running since the early 2000s in Shan State.
results.description:
Most of Myanmar’s manganese mines have been running since the early 2000s in Shan State.

The NDAA, backed by the United Wa State Party and with deep ties to China, used those connections to become a powerhouse in rare earth and jade mining.
